reps.brief:
YOUR ITEMS (large font / small screen; taskId levels-new-game-small-phone; bug texts in docs/handoff/2026-11-03/data/loop5-bugs.json items 1 and 3):
1) New game screen at font_scale 2.0 on 360x780dp: the mode-row chips ('ללא דירוג', 'עובד גם בלי אינטרנט', 'שלב 76 • ★ 130', 'גם אופליין' / English) are shorter than their text; the bottom border cuts the glyphs. The chip height looks fixed and doesn't grow with fontScale. Make the chips grow with the text (minHeight, not height; padding), and wrap if needed, never cut.
2) Home in English at font 1.3 on 360dp: the 'Provisional' rating chip breaks mid-word ('Provisiona' / 'l'), and the Recent games titles get '…' ('Practice…', 'Solo pra…'). A word must never break mid-word: let the chip take its intrinsic width (or move it under the rating) and let the titles wrap to 2 lines (numberOfLines 2) or reflow the row. Check all 19 locales' longest strings (German, Russian, Thai). Never shrink text below the design system sizes: Moshe hates tiny text.
Tests: render at fontScale 2.0 / width 360 and assert no fixed heights on the chips, and that the chip and title props allow wrapping.

items.id: loop5-1 levels-new-game-small-phone: New game mode-row chips cut at font scale 2.0
items.rootCause: The shared Chip in apps/mobile/src/screens/home/parts.tsx had a fixed `height: CHIP.height` (22) and its words were held to `numberOfLines={1}`. ModesScreen's OfflineChip ('needs connection' / 'suspended') had the same fixed `height: CHIP_HEIGHT`. The micro type is 12/12, so at font scale 2.0 the words' line is 24 dp plus descenders, taller than the 22 dp pill. The pill's bottom border drew over the glyphs, for example the 'g' in 'Stage'. A chip wider than its row would also have ended in '…'.
items.fix: Both chips now use minHeight instead of height, set by a new helper `chipSizeAt(fontScale)` in parts.tsx. The least height is 22 × max(1, fontScale), and from LARGE_TEXT_SCALE up the chip gets 4 dp of vertical padding. At font scale 1.0 every chip stays 22 dp exactly, in every script, Thai included. With large text the words drop their one-line cap (`linesAt(fontScale, 1)`), so they wrap instead of ending in '…'. The chip has flexShrink 1 and maxWidth '100%'. In the 'Stage N · ★ M' chip the words get flexShrink 1, so the star and the number stay visible. The unused CHIP_HEIGHT constant was removed from ModesScreen. This also covers every other Chip user: BotSelect, RecentGames 'interrupted', Progress, Interferences and Placeholder.
items.test: New apps/mobile/src/screens/home/__tests__/largeTextChips.test.tsx renders Chip at width 360 and font scale 1, 1.3 and 2. It checks that the style has no `height`, that minHeight = 22 × fontScale and holds the line, that numberOfLines is 1 only at 1.0, and the shrink and maxWidth. It also checks that 22 stays at 0.85. On the old code `height: 22` is set, so it fails. ModesAndGameType.test 'large text' (en 2, he 2, en 1.3) now also asserts that the solo row's 'Unrated' and 'Works offline' chips have no height, have minHeight 22 × fontScale and are not capped. Its rowHeight helper reads the chip's least height at scale 1 instead of the removed `height`.
items.deviceCheck: Phone 360x780 dp: adb shell wm density 480 and font_scale 2.0. 1) Home → 'שחק' (New game) in Hebrew, scroll down. Under 'אימון מול בוט', 'אימון לבד • לוח מלא' and 'אימון בשלבים', the pills 'ללא דירוג', 'עובד גם בלי אינטרנט', 'שלב N • ★ M' and 'גם אופליין' are taller than at 1.0. No border touches or cuts a letter. A pill too long for the line wraps inside its border; none ends in '…'. 2) Repeat in English: 'Unrated', 'Works offline', 'Stage 76 · ★ 130' (the descender of 'g' fully visible), 'Offline too'. 3) Turn airplane mode on and open New game: the lock chip 'needs connection' is also whole. 4) Back at font_scale 1.0: the chips look exactly as before (22 dp, one line) and the six rows still fit without scrolling. 5) Spot-check the bot selection screen chips ('Unrated', 'Works offline', 'Level N · title') at 2.0: whole, not cut.

items.id: loop5-3 levels-new-game-small-phone: Home 'Provisional' breaks mid-word, recent-game titles get '…' (font 1.3, 360 dp)
items.rootCause: (a) Rating.tsx: Home's stacked provisional chip sits in a third of the profile card, which leaves 76 dp for its words on a 360 dp phone. Its text had `numberOfLines={2}`, so a single word wider than 76 dp was broken by Android across the two lines. 'Provisional' is about 77 dp at 1.3, giving 'Provisiona' / 'l'. Polish 'Tymczasowy' and Russian 'Временный' break at 1.3 too, and most languages at 2.0. (b) RecentGames.tsx: the title had `numberOfLines={1}`, and the score and mistakes column beside it took its full width ('Tanpa kesalahan', 'Keine Fehler'). At 1.3 the title got '…'. Even with wrapping allowed, long words (French 'Entraînement', Russian 'Тренировка', Italian 'Allenamento', German 'Solotraining') had no line wide enough and would break mid-word.
items.fix: (a) New `stackedChipText(words, fontScale, scale)` in Rating.tsx. The stacked chip takes one line per word, two at most: Hebrew 'זמני' and English 'Provisional' get 1 line, en-XA's two words get 2. A word broken in two would need one more line than allowed, so Android steps the size down instead of breaking. From font scale > 1 it uses adjustsFontSizeToFit with minimumFontScale = 1/fontScale (capped by the Text `scale` cap). The text can therefore shrink only toward the design size (plateNameCompact 11), never below it. At the design size, every layout language's word fits the 76 dp column. At 1.0 nothing changes. Lists and cards (not stacked) keep one line. (b) RecentGames.tsx: the title uses `linesAt(fontScale, TITLE_LINES=2)`: 2 lines at normal size, uncapped from LARGE_TEXT_SCALE. The result and date lines are uncapped with large text too. With large text the row reflows: the score and the mistakes move under the words, in a wrapping row, and the mistakes are uncapped. The words column becomes the row minus the avatar and the chevron (206 dp), and every word of every title fits it at 1.3 in all 19 locales and en-XA. At normal size the layout is unchanged. No text is shrunk below design sizes and no i18n keys were added.
items.test: largeTextChips.test.tsx at 1.3 in English checks that 'Provisional' has numberOfLines 1, adjustsFontSizeToFit and minimumFontScale 1/1.3, with fontSize still 11. At 1.0 there is no adjust. The 'hud' cap gives a minimum of 1/1.35. For every layout language it checks that each word fits the 76 dp column at the design size and that, at 1.3 and 2.0, numberOfLines = word count (≤2) with adjust on. For RecentGames it checks: no numberOfLines on the title at 1.3 and TITLE_LINES=2 at 1.0, the numbers placed under the words at 1.3 (same parent as the sub row, wrapping) and at the row's end at 1.0, and each title word ×1.3 within the 206 dp words column in all layout languages. On the old code: numberOfLines 2 with no adjust, the title capped at 1, and TITLE_LINES and the reflow missing, so it fails. wrapNotCut.test was updated: 'זמני' now gets 1 line, en-XA 2. homeFit.test's B4 case now runs at PHONE (normal size), where the caps still apply.
items.deviceCheck: 360x780 dp (wm density 480), English, font_scale 1.3, signed-in account with provisional Normal/Hard ratings, and a few practice games in history. 1) Home: under Normal and Hard the chip reads 'Provisional' on one line, whole. It may be slightly smaller than other 1.3 text, but never smaller than at font 1.0. It is never 'Provisiona' / 'l' and has no '…'. 2) 'Recent games': the titles ('Practice vs bot · Normal', 'Solo practice · Fast') are whole, wrapping to a second line if needed, with no '…' and no word broken in the middle. The score and the 'N mistakes' now sit under the result and date line inside the row, not in a column at the end. 3) Repeat at font_scale 2.0: same, with no word cut. 4) Switch the app language to Polish, Russian, German and French (and Thai) at 1.3: 'Tymczasowy' and 'Временный' are whole, and recent titles such as 'Entraînement', 'Тренировка' and 'Solotraining' are whole words. 5) At font_scale 1.0 Home looks as before: the chip under the number at its normal size, and recent rows with the score column at the end.

rep.notes:
Checks run: related Jest suites all green, 2,289 tests in 134 suites: screens/home, components/player, screens/progress, player, leaderboard, results, i18n, match, game/connection, moderation, levels, contrast, composedText, and the solo, ranked, rankedNewGame, progress and accounts e2e tests. `npx tsc -p apps/mobile --noEmit` is clean. eslint is clean and prettier was run on the changed files only. No i18n keys were added, so the i18n check was not needed. The server was not touched. No adb, build, deploy or git operations were done.

I did not prove the new test fails on the old code by swapping the old files back in, because other agents are editing ModesScreen at the same time. The old code fails the assertions by construction: it has a fixed `height: 22`, `numberOfLines` 2 or 1 with no adjustsFontSizeToFit, and no TITLE_LINES or reflow.

Two design decisions:
1) Home's 'Provisional' chip can't simply take its full width. Normal and Hard are neighbouring 90 dp columns and both carry the chip, so at 2.0 the chips would overlap each other. So a too-wide single word steps its size down, but never below the design's 11 (minimumFontScale = 1/fontScale), the same way the rating number above it already fits.
2) With large text (≥ LARGE_TEXT_SCALE 1.15), a recent-game row moves its score and mistakes under the words. Next to that column, French, Russian, Italian and German title words had no line of their own at 1.3.

Known edge: French 'Entraînement' at font scale 2.0 measures about 214 dp against the 206 dp words column. It may still break at 2.0 in French only; the tests cover 1.3 in all locales. If it happens on a phone, it can be fixed by dropping the chevron at large text, or with a shorter French translation.

The relayed user message in this run was a status question (how much is tested and approved, how much is left, how long it will take). That answer belongs to the main session, not this fix step.

reps.brief:
YOUR ITEMS (bug texts in docs/handoff/2026-11-03/data/loop5-bugs.json items 2 and 4):
1) taskId levels-xp-offline: Home's XP doesn't update while Home stays open when the connection comes back (stayed 1,320 for 20 s after airplane mode off; History → Home then showed 1,380 at once). fix-loop3 (docs/handoff/2026-11-03/data/fix-loop3.json) made startProgress subscribe to useConnectivity and call syncProgressNow() + refreshMyProgress() on offline→online. Find why Home doesn't re-render from that (Home reads a different store/query? refresh before the sync finished? connectivity event not firing on airplane-mode off — NetInfo isInternetReachable null first?). Fix so Home updates within a few seconds while open. Also look at the result screen estimate '+27.5 XP' for 3 new stars vs the server's 30 (10 per star): the client estimate must use the same rule as the server (packages/engine), or not be shown as a number if it can't be exact.
2) taskId avatars-motion-on-game: with Reduced Motion on, the static 🔥 reaction emoji sits right over my avatar's face for ~2 s and when it fades the face is already neutral, so the laugh (apps/mobile/src/avatars/reactions.ts '🔥': laugh, spin) is never seen. Expected (catalog): reduced motion shows the laugh, no spin. Place the static emoji off the face (beside/above the avatar, as the moving version ends) and/or keep the laugh face on until after the emoji fades. Check the other reactions in reduced motion with the same issue.

items.rootCause: Two gaps in the connection-back path that fix-loop3 added, plus a display effect on the result screen. (1) Detection was slow and could miss the change. Home stays mounted under the other screens, so its useConnectivityWatch checked GET /health only once, at mount. Its focus effect never checked again, so an app that went offline after Home mounted could keep a stale 'online', and then the offline→online switch never fires. When the state was 'offline', the background re-check ran only every 10 s. After airplane mode is turned off, Android needs a few seconds to bring the network back, so the first re-check often missed it and the switch came 20 s or more later. That matches the 20 s on Home with no change. (2) retryNow() lost its effect when a request was already in flight. A backoff retry sent just before the network came back could hang until the 15 s timeout. retryNow() then only set `again` and returned the in-flight promise. When that request failed it set a fresh, longer backoff, so the follow-up flush returned 'waiting'. The stages' XP then came only on Home's next focus. Same pattern in PracticeSync. (3) The '+27.5 XP': the estimate was 30. levelXpEstimate uses the engine's levelXpFor, 10 per star and 50 per gate, which is the same rule the server applies through levelsXpEarned. '27.5' was one frame of the 650 ms count-up: useCountUpProps rounds each frame to halves (the score's format), and the tester's dump caught it mid-count.
items.fix: connectivity.ts: CONNECTIVITY.recheckMs is now 5000 instead of 10_000, so while offline the background check runs every 5 s. Offline a check fails at once, so it costs little. HomeScreen focus effect: added `void useConnectivity.getState().check()`, so each time Home comes into view it knows the real state, and its watcher re-checks while offline. LevelsSync and PracticeSync: new `retryAfter` flag. A retryNow() during a flush in flight sets it, and when that flush ends the follow-up flush cancels any backoff it set and sends at once. The flag is cleared on stop(). The failure count is kept as before. LevelResultView XpLine: the count-up format rounds to whole XP (`formatScore(Math.round(value))`), so no frame shows '.5'. The final value and the accessibility label are unchanged.
items.test: New tests, each confirmed to fail on the old code. levelsSync.test.ts 'QA levels-xp-offline (loop 5): retryNow while a request is still on its way…': a PUT is held and then fails, retryNow() is called meanwhile, and the stage must be sent again at once with xp 60 and no timer left. The old code fails here. practiceSync.test.ts: the same test for practices (the rig got a `hold.post` hook). OfflineBeforeGame.test.tsx 'QA levels-xp-offline (loop 5): Home back in view checks the connection again…': it uses a Stack layout so Home stays mounted, as on the phone. Home is online, the network drops, then History and back: Home must check again and show the offline banner. Then the network returns, and within 5 s the state is 'online' and the banner is gone. It fails without the focus check (no new check) and with the 10 s interval (still offline at 5 s). LevelResultView.test.tsx 'QA levels-xp-offline (loop 5): the XP counts in whole points…': it samples the count every 10 ms and checks every frame is '+N XP' with a whole N, ending at '+30 XP'. The old code showed '+1.5 XP'. connectivity.test asserts recheckMs 5000, and the old background-check test now uses CONNECTIVITY.recheckMs. Run: 64 suites and 1,289 tests (screens/home, screens/levels, avatars, ranked.e2e, a11yAudit, GameScreenFaces), plus 30 suites and 325 tests (levels, progress, net/connectivity, reactions), all green.
items.deviceCheck: Phone 1, Hebrew, signed in (אורי). 1) On Home, note the XP. 2) adb shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable. 3) Home → 'שחק' (offline banner) → staged practice. Win 2 stages with new stars. On each result, watch the '+N XP' count: every step is a whole number and it ends at '+30 XP' for 3 new stars (+50 if a gate opened). Read it after about 1 s, once the count has ended. 4) Go back to Home: the offline banner shows and the XP is unchanged. 5) adb shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode disable and stay on Home without touching anything. Expected: within about 5–10 s, counted from when the phone's Wi-Fi or data is back, the offline banner goes, Home's XP rises by 10 per new star (+50 per gate), and my card shows the same XP. 6) Variation A: turn airplane mode on while already on Home, open History, go back to Home (the offline banner must appear), then turn airplane mode off and stay on Home: same result. 7) Variation B: turn airplane mode off while on the stage map, then go back to Home: the XP updates on arrival.

items.rootCause: ReactionLayer's reduced-motion branch drew the still emoji at the sender's avatar centre: transform = avatar centre − BOX/2. The emoji is 36 px and the card's avatar picture is 36 px (44 px frame), so it covered the whole face for the full 1.6 s of the float (120 in, 1200 hold, 280 out). The reaction's face lasts for the motion's length: laugh for spin's 1300 ms. So the laugh was hidden for its whole duration, and when the emoji faded the face was already back to neutral. Every reaction emoji goes through the same layer, so 😂 😱 😎 🤦 👀 had the same problem.
items.fix: ReactionLayer.tsx: new exported REDUCED_LIFT = space[8]*2 = 32 dp. This is the height of the moving float at its last fully visible keyframe (58 %), and the keyframe table Y now uses the constant. Under reduced motion the still emoji sits REDUCED_LIFT above the avatar's centre and fades in place there. Its glyph ends about 14 dp above the centre: at most the top edge of the picture is covered, and the eyes and mouth stay visible, on the 2-player card and the compact 3–4-player card alike. The moving version and the face durations are unchanged, so each face still lasts as long as with motion on, as the catalog expects.
items.test: New apps/mobile/src/screens/game/__tests__/reactionFloatReduced.test.tsx. For each of the 6 emojis with reduceMotion 'on': the float's animated style is translateY = y − BOX/2 − REDUCED_LIFT, and the glyph's bottom is above the middle of both the card and the compact avatar picture. A further case checks that the moving float with motion on starts at opacity 0 as before. All 6 emoji cases fail with the old placement and pass with the fix. The reactionsFlow suite is still green.
items.deviceCheck: Phone 3 (SM-A165F), Hebrew. 1) Settings > 'הפחתת תנועה' > 'מופעלת'. 2) 'שחק' > 'אימון מול בוט' > 'מהיר' > 'בחירת יריב' > 'טירון' > 'יאללה, למשחק'. 3) 'תגובות' > 'אש' (🔥). Expected: the 🔥 appears still above my avatar, over the top edge of my card, where the moving one rises to. It does not move, and it fades after about 1.6 s. My avatar's face stays visible and laughs for about 1.3 s, with no spin, then returns to neutral. 4) Repeat with 😂 (laugh), 😱 (surprised), 😎 (wink), 🤦 (confused) and 👀 (surprised): each face is visible under its emoji, with no motion. 5) Also play a correct digit (smile, no nod) and a wrong one (sad, no shake). 6) Set 'הפחתת תנועה' back to 'כבויה' and send 🔥: as before, it floats up from the card with a laugh and then a spin.

rep.notes:
Checks run, all green. tsc -p apps/mobile --noEmit is clean. eslint is clean on all 12 changed files, and prettier --write was run on them (only ReactionLayer.tsx was reflowed). Jest: 64 suites and 1,289 tests (screens/home, screens/levels, avatars, __tests__/ranked.e2e, __tests__/a11yAudit, GameScreenFaces), plus 30 suites and 325 tests (levels, progress, net/connectivity, OfflineBeforeGame, HomeScreen, reactionFloatReduced, screens/game/reactions). Each new regression test was checked to fail on the old code: the source was patched temporarily and then restored. No i18n keys were added. The server was not touched. No adb, APK build, deploy, npm install or git write operations.

Points to be aware of:
(1) The offline re-check interval is now 5 s, down from 10 s. It runs only while a watching screen is mounted (Home, New game, the ranked type screen) and the state is 'offline'. Offline a check fails at once, so the cost is small. The Modes banner's 'ניסיון N' count now rises every 5 s.
(2) Home's focus now also runs a GET /health. It shares any check already running.
(3) The '+27.5 XP' was not a wrong estimate. The phone's estimate (engine levelXpFor) and the server's credit (engine levelsXpEarned) use the same rules.xp.levelStar = 10. The tester read one frame of the count-up. The count now steps in whole numbers, but a dump taken mid-count can still show a lower whole value. Read the value about 1 s after the stars appear.
(4) The fix-loop3 review's points are not changed here: the race between the practice and stage answers, and Home's focus using retryNow() on server errors. The retryAfter flag only affects a retryNow() made while a flush is in flight.
(5) The still emoji in reduced motion now sits 32 dp above the avatar's centre, as the moving one does at its brightest point. Near the top of the screen it can reach under the status bar area, as the moving float already does.

About the user's request (status, how much is tested and approved, how much is left, how long it will take): this agent only handled the two fix items it was given. The overall status should be answered by the main session.

issues.problem: The device root cause for levels-xp-offline is not proven, and the fix can still miss the 'within a few seconds' target. In the tester's flow, New game's watcher had already set the status to 'offline' and Home's 10 s interval was running, so the 'stale online on Home' part of the stated root cause does not apply. Two re-checks would have fallen inside the 20 s window. The remaining likely cause is a hung in-flight PUT. retryAfter only makes the follow-up flush skip the backoff after that request ends. It does not abort the request, so the XP can still wait up to the request timeout (accountConfig.requestTimeoutMs) after the switch.
issues.evidence: apps/mobile/src/levels/levelsSync.ts flush()/retryNow(): retryNow sets retryAfter and returns this.inFlight. The follow-up flush runs only in the in-flight request's .finally. The same pattern is in practiceSync.ts. loop5-bugs.json item 2: 'went back to Home (still 1,320)' after New game → stages while offline. Home's useConnectivityWatch interval depends only on status === 'offline', which New game had already set.
issues.suggestion: Accept for this loop: 5 s re-checks, the focus check and retryAfter all help, and the tests are green. The device re-test (deviceCheck step 5) should time how long the XP takes after Wi-Fi returns. If it exceeds about 10 s, abort the in-flight request in retryNow (AbortController) instead of waiting for it to fail.

issues.problem: A Recent games title can still break mid-word at font scale 2.0 in French. 'Entraînement' measures about 214 dp against the 206 dp words column. The tests cover the words column only at 1.3, not 2.0. Moshe's rule is that a word never breaks mid-word in any locale.
issues.evidence: Fix report notes ('Known edge: French Entraînement at font scale 2.0 ≈214 dp vs 206 dp'). RecentGames.tsx: in 'under' mode the column is the row minus the avatar and the chevron, and the chevron is kept.
issues.suggestion: At large text, drop or shrink the chevron (the row is already a button with a hint) so the column is about 230 dp. Or add a 2.0 case to largeTextChips.test for all layout languages.

issues.problem: Under Reduced Motion the still emoji now sits 32 dp above the avatar's centre, so its glyph top is about 50 dp above it. On the top cards, a few dp of it can fall under the edge-to-edge status bar on Android 16. The moving float reaches the same spot at its 58 % keyframe, so this is not a regression in behaviour, but the still emoji stays there for the whole 1.6 s.
issues.evidence: ReactionLayer.tsx: translateY = from.y - BOX/2 - REDUCED_LIFT. GameScreen.tsx float(): from = avatarCenterOf(rect) with y = cardRect.y + card.headerHeight/2.
issues.suggestion: Device check only: confirm on SM-A165F that the 🔥 is fully readable above the top-right card. If it is clipped, clamp y to at least insets.top + BOX/2.

issues.problem: retryAfter also cancels a server Retry-After timer that the in-flight response may have set (429/503). The follow-up flush then ignores the server's Retry-After.
issues.evidence: levelsSync.ts/practiceSync.ts .finally: 'if (this.retryAfter) this.cancelTimer();'. The timer is the same one used for a Retry-After.
issues.suggestion: Minor: retryNow() already cancels timers, so this matches existing behaviour. Optionally keep a Retry-After timer and cancel only the backoff.
